multipleTestingBudget.method: Bonferroni across three claim families; Holm within each family

validation.selectionRule: development-supported positive Brier/log gain ranked per target/horizon/family; fixed lower-bound agreement; equal-weight supporting families; independent confirmation required
limitations: Whole-day bootstrap/sign-flip assumes adequately exchangeable day blocks and is approximate.
Timestamp replay assumes immediate availability; real feed delivery and game actions are not tested.
Several models use the same observations; distinct families are not proof of statistical independence.
Next-k any-event probability is neither payout probability nor profitability of a particular stake.
Hawkes maps round horizons using training cadence; clock models predict only next round near the known origin time.

multipleTesting.method: Holm within frozen candidates; Bonferroni suite-family allocation

timeZones.selectionRule: DEV positive Jeffreys-smoothed inside-minus-outside frequency lift; at most three nonoverlapping centers per target/radius; no CONF selection
timeZones.decisionTime: previous completed round timestamp; next-one-round outcome; cross-day, gap and tied pairs unknown
timeZones.lossDenominator: all known decision origins per heldout day; outside-zone predictions equal training-global baseline
timeZones.intervalMethod: descriptive Wilson 95% binomial event intervals; whole-day paired bootstrap/sign-flip loss validation
limitations: Clock association is not a payout or profitability guarantee.
Binomial event intervals do not model dependence between rounds; day-block loss inference is approximate.
Timestamp replay assumes the completed round was available immediately.
